name: Sharav
site_title: Sharav — Mizrahi Jewish Cooking at Your Farmers Market
site_description: Sharav brings the warmth, depth, and story of Mizrahi Jewish cuisine to farmers markets in the Washington DC / Maryland area. Sabich, malawach, burekas, and more, made fresh.
hero_eyebrow: Mizrahi Jewish Cooking · Washington DC & Maryland
hero_heading: The heat and warmth of Mizrahi cooking, fresh at the market.
hero_sub: Sharav (שרב) is a Hebrew word for the shimmering desert heat haze — warmth, intensity, and richness, just like the food. We're bringing the bold spices, slow-cooked flavors, and generations-old recipes of Iraqi, Yemenite, Persian, and North African Jewish kitchens to a booth near you.
about_body: Mizrahi cuisine is the food of Jewish communities from the Middle East and North Africa — Iraq, Iran, Yemen, Morocco, Tunisia, Libya, Syria, and Egypt — blending Levantine, Persian, and North African traditions. Think bold spices, slow-cooked meats, pickled vegetables, flaky flatbreads, and condiments like amba (pickled mango) and zhug (green chili sauce). It's not generic "Mediterranean" food — it's a cuisine with deep cultural roots and a story rarely told outside the community that keeps it alive.
mission: To bring the warmth, depth, and story of Mizrahi Jewish cuisine to our community — one plate at a time.
menu_heading: Made in small batches, market to market
menu_sub: Our lineup is a rotating, farmers-market-friendly selection from a much bigger family of recipes. Ask at the booth what's fresh this week.
find_us_heading: Catch us at a market near you
find_us_body: We're launching at farmers markets around the Washington DC / Maryland area. Our weekly schedule is still being finalized as we lock in markets for the season — the fastest way to know exactly where we'll be is to follow along on Instagram.
